description.en: Plays a Minecraft villager sound each time a hmm-like interjection appears in the model reasoning stream or reply. Ships a draggable panel showing the hit count, with a pause toggle and an editable matcher.
description.zh: 模型的思维链或回复里出现 hmm、嗯、唔 等哼声时，播放一次 Minecraft 村民音效。附带可拖动面板，显示命中次数，可暂停监听，并可编辑匹配式。
